parts.title: Listening - Part 1 (Picture Multiple Choice)
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer (A, B, or C).

questions.question: When is the Christmas office party?
What will the boy do at the youth club on Fridays?
What is the woman going to get her sister for her birthday?

parts.title: Listening - Part 4 (Short Extracts Multiple Choice)
parts.instructions: For each question, choose the correct answer.

questions.question: You will hear a woman talking to her friend about her new boss. What does the woman like about him?
You will hear a man talking about a basketball match. How did he feel after the match?
You will hear a teacher talking about a lesson. What has changed?
You will hear a woman talking to her friend about her house. What’s the problem with the house?
You will hear a man talking about a job. Why didn’t he get it?

options.A: He didn’t want it as much as others.
options.C: He was late for the meeting.
